question: VXZA is related to WYAB in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, YACD is related to ZBDE. To which of the following is BDFG related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, VXZA is related to WYAB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5862f21542e43d11b1319a2d7366e9ddb620e4cc4463fd0d16f2b8fac31c7120.png] 

For, YACD is related to ZBDE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/293230f5f7c2ab24a0a27da74b5a9a26bf374b8642661f8be764f2996cd85aeb.png] 

Similarly, for **BDFG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b9586c383746669faf684b46cce9ab8bccfb92f1d178ab8b705f5ee87d39f9d.png] 

So, BDFG will be related to **CEGH.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
